note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_study_guide.py; type=manual require agent/render/research inspection.

GATE_1_configuration.text: Title accepted verbatim; Title Clearance record with sources and scan date; non-affiliation statement queued if a protected exam name appears
Exam Format Evidence record exists with live sources dated to this engagement; profile locked from evidence (Research Before Generation gate)
Examination Scope Evidence record exists; chapter plan mirrors the official blueprint with domains and weighting; syllabus-coverage map recorded chapter by chapter
Marketplace-integrity modifier recorded for region-locked exams (jurisdiction, marketplace, bulletin source)
Subtitle states the exact question count with 'Practice Questions', letters/numerals/spaces only, two rendered lines max

Byline fetched live, collision-checked, locked; Title Design Signature cleared against the Catalog Design Register; Language Profile Card locked; assessment plan maps sets to chapters with seed recorded
Set count and questions per set derived from operator-supplied total; sets map to chapters; numbering continuous 1..total

GATE_2_per_chapter.text: Template complete: title, Learning Objectives box (exact lead line), intro prose, How to Use box, subchapters with Exam Tip/Common Mistake boxes, Key Points close
>=2 captioned data tables and >=2 content figures per chapter
>=3 substantive paragraphs per subchapter, definition -> mechanism -> applied example -> examiner relevance; practice items answerable from the chapter alone
Running chapters total projected against the 60-page absolute ceiling (61+ is a blocking FAIL); target band 50-60
Chapter maps to its blueprint domain; no domain silently dropped or merged
Per-chapter format audit with rendered inspection; six-line floor verified; boxes unsplit; tables flush to margins; embedded figures or anchored prompt blocks; chapter preview delivered

GATE_3_assessment.text: Every item's type, option count, labels, and instruction conventions match the Exam Format Evidence record; full-width types break the columns correctly
Set-to-chapter mapping honored; item difficulty mix follows the researched blueprint weighting; pure recall is the minority
Question count equals answer count; numbering continuous without gaps or duplicates
Answer-key distribution balanced per set within one of even (quota tolerance)
Run cap held; no four-letter permutation doubled; no two-letter alternation tripled; Two Option Law raises two-option cap to >=2 (default 3)
Every answer entry carries an Explanation of at most 50 words, content-based, no letter references
Text at new key equals text at old key; option multisets match; seed recorded; pins, flags, and any auto-raised cap reported
Every declared exhibit embedded; no undeclared or merely illustrative exhibit; dimension labels never A through D

GATE_4_release.text: Every blueprint domain covered by a chapter and tested by mapped items in proportion to its weighting; any gap is a blocking FAIL
Item-format fidelity re-checked across the full bank against the evidence record
Printed folios equal actual for every entry; complete map; zero 'undefined' residue; no pseudo-headings before every Contents pass
Preface/Introduction/Conclusion each 1.40 to 1.55 pages; chapters total 50 to 60 pages
Contrast >=4.5:1 on actual file values; compliance characters absent; table/margin alignment exact; front matter folio-free; Arabic numbering from Introduction with no restart; live folio fields
No IMAGE PROMPT marker; balanced table tags; no symlinks; no embedded PDF
Non-affiliation statement present where required; jurisdiction disclaimer complete; candidate bulletin in Suggested Readings; no implied relevance in marketplaces where the exam does not exist
Byline appears exactly twice (title page, copyright), name only, no credentials; PASS only after actual file and rendered page inspection; UNVERIFIED blocks as FAIL
